About Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) powers the world's most demanding workloads, helping organizations innovate with secure, high-performance cloud services. As OCI continues its rapid growth, we're investing in operational excellence, strategic initiatives, and scalable business processes that enable our teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and accelerate innovation.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Business Program Manager  to help drive strategic business initiatives that support OCI's continued growth. This role will partner across product, engineering, operations, finance, and executive leadership to coordinate high-impact programs, improve operational effectiveness, and ensure successful execution of key business priorities.

As a Senior Business Program Manager , you will lead cross-functional programs that support OCI's strategic priorities, including expanding the adoption of AI-enabled business capabilities, improving operational efficiency, and driving initiatives that strengthen OCI's networking and storage businesses.

Rather than owning technical implementation, you will focus on bringing together diverse stakeholders, establishing governance, driving execution, managing risks, and ensuring organizational alignment across multiple teams. You will help translate strategic priorities into actionable plans while providing leadership with the visibility and insights needed to make informed decisions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges, improving operational processes, and leading programs that have broad organizational impact.

Eligibility and Location Requirements
This position requires U.S. citizenship and is located onsite in Saline, Michigan. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle's relocation policies.
Key Responsibilities

- Lead daily operations, maintenance, and service execution for critical mechanical and HVAC infrastructure.

- Own mechanical plant readiness, including preventive maintenance, corrective work, inspections, restoration activities, and maintenance backlog management.

- Serve as the primary site point of contact and technical lead for mechanical systems, including incident escalation and operational decision support.

- Manage Facilities Technicians, contractors, and service vendors, ensuring strong safety performance, quality of work, documentation rigor, and SLA adherence.

- Drive troubleshooting and response for mechanical failures, abnormal conditions, and performance degradation impacting uptime or operational stability.

- Track and improve KPIs such as equipment availability, backlog health, MTTR, repeat failures, maintenance completion, and corrective action closure.

- Partner with engineering, commissioning, deployment, reliability, and controls teams on retrofits, upgrades, system turnover, and operational acceptance.

- Lead or support root cause analysis for major or recurring issues and ensure corrective actions are fully implemented, verified, and sustained.

- Maintain audit-ready records including procedures, service reports, maintenance history, turnover documentation, and CMMS data.

- Champion safe work practices, environmental compliance, and disciplined process execution across all mechanical operations.

- Coach and develop technicians and frontline leads to strengthen troubleshooting capability, technical depth, and execution consistency.

- Support the Site Operations Director with status reporting, risk visibility, staffing readiness, and operational improvement initiatives for the mechanical plant.

Qualifications

- 5–8 years of experience in mechanical plant operations, HVAC service, critical cooling maintenance, or related uptime-critical environments such as data centers, healthcare, industrial plants, semiconductor, or large commercial facilities.

- 2–4+ years of experience leading technicians, maintenance teams, or service providers in a live operational environment.

- Strong knowledge of chilled water systems, cooling towers, pumps, CRAHs, AHUs, CDUs, and related controls platforms.

- Experience managing vendors, maintenance programs, incident response, and service execution in 24x7 operations.

- Familiarity with BMS, SCADA, DCIM, and CMMS tools.

- Experience supporting commissioning, turnover, or operational acceptance of new or upgraded mechanical systems is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting judgment and calm decision-making under pressure.

- Deep commitment to safety, procedure adherence, and documentation rigor.

- Clear communicator able to translate plant conditions, risks, and actions for varied stakeholders.

- Strong planning and execution discipline across maintenance, backlog, and operational priorities.

- Ability to lead technicians and vendors while reinforcing accountability and consistent field execution.

Preferred Skills / Certifications

- Experience with mission-critical cooling infrastructure and redundancy strategies in high-availability environments.

- Familiarity with predictive maintenance, trend analysis, controls integration, and operational performance monitoring.

- EPA Section 608 Certification preferred where refrigerant-handling responsibilities apply.

- HVAC trade license, mechanical certification, or equivalent technical qualification where applicable.

- OEM or manufacturer training on chillers, cooling systems, pumps, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC systems, or related controls platforms preferred.

- OSHA 30 preferred.

Physical Demands / Work Environment
This is a mission-critical onsite role supporting 24/7 operations where continuous uptime is essential; as such, regular attendance, schedule flexibility, and response readiness are required. To perform these duties, you must be able to frequently walk, bend, kneel, crouch, push/pull objects, and climb stairs. You may be required to lift or move up to 39 pounds independently and participate in group lifts for loads 40 pounds or greater. You must also be capable of maintaining balance while working from ladders or elevated platforms. These tasks are performed in an industrial environment and must be executed safely, with or without reasonable accommodation, to maintain the continuous health of facility infrastructure.

Why Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?

Global impact at scale: Contribute directly to how mission-critical OCI data centers operate across regions and continents, influencing infrastructure reliability, security, sustainability, and long-term capacity growth.

Technically rigorous environment: Work alongside experienced engineers, automation specialists, and compliance teams in a rapidly scaling hyperscale cloud infrastructure, where disciplined execution and technical depth matter.

Culture built on operational excellence: Join an organization that values safety, process rigor, clear accountability, and continuous improvement as foundational to protecting uptime and customer trust.

Long-term career development: Benefit from internal mobility, role-based technical training, and development opportunities designed for professionals building long-term careers in cloud infrastructure and facilities operations.
This position requires U.S. citizenship and is located onsite in Saline, Michigan. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle's relocation policies.

As Facilities Operations Manager – Mechanical, you will lead the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of mission-critical mechanical systems supporting OCI data centers. Reporting to the Site Operations Director, this role owns mechanical plant operations, maintenance execution, vendor performance, operational readiness, and technician leadership across cooling and HVAC infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Business Operations Lead (Nashville, TN)
jobs.description:
The Global Program Controls organization provides governance, reporting, controls processes, cost management support, and portfolio visibility to help Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deliver global data center programs with greater consistency, transparency, and execution discipline.

We are seeking a highly experienced individual contributor to help transform complex operational and technical information into accurate, decision-ready insights for senior executives.

This role is designed for someone who is relentless about data integrity, intellectually curious, highly responsive, and comfortable operating in a complex, fast-moving, technical environment. The successful candidate will be able to move fluidly between detailed operational data and CEO-level communication—digging into the underlying facts, identifying inconsistencies, resolving ambiguity, and distilling the results into clear, concise, and credible executive reporting.

This is not a traditional data analyst, project manager, or communications role. It combines elements of all three. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical judgment, executive communication skills, technical aptitude, and a delivery-oriented mindset. Prior data center experience is not required. More important is a genuine interest in learning technical subject matter and the ability to become conversant in areas such as data center operations, low-voltage infrastructure, rack and compute deployment, hardware testing, and server turn-up activities.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integrity and Analytical Rigor

- Establish confidence in the accuracy, consistency, completeness, and traceability of critical business and operational data.

- Investigate discrepancies across systems, reports, teams, and data sources, and drive issues through resolution.

- Ask probing questions, challenge unsupported assumptions, and ensure that reported information can withstand executive scrutiny.

- Develop practical processes and controls that improve data quality and reporting reliability over time.

- Identify gaps in available information and work across teams to establish a clear, defensible source of truth.

- Balance speed with precision, particularly during time-sensitive executive requests and operational escalations.

Executive Reporting and Communication

- Translate highly technical, tactical, or operational information into clear and compelling narratives for the CEO and other senior executives.

- Produce executive reports, briefings, presentations, summaries, and decision-support materials.

- Distill large volumes of information into the few insights, risks, decisions, and actions that matter most.

- Tailor the depth, language, and format of communications to the intended executive audience.

- Ensure that executive materials are accurate, concise, logically structured, and supported by verifiable data.

- Anticipate likely executive questions and prepare the supporting analysis needed to answer them.

Business and Technical Learning

- Develop a deep understanding of the company’s business model, operations, technology, customers, systems, and key performance drivers.

- Become comfortable with technical concepts related to data center operations, low-voltage work, rack and compute deployment, hardware validation and testing, server installation, and server turn-up.

- Learn unfamiliar technical and operational subject matter quickly, even without prior domain experience.

- Engage confidently with engineers, operators, vendors, and subject-matter experts to understand technical processes, terminology, dependencies, and risks.

- Ask thoughtful questions and continue learning until able to accurately explain technical topics to both operational and executive audiences.

- Build strong working relationships with subject-matter experts and learn enough to challenge, clarify, and synthesize their input.

- Connect information across functions to identify broader implications, dependencies, risks, and opportunities.

- Approach technical subject matter with curiosity, humility, and genuine enthusiasm rather than hesitation or avoidance.

Program Execution and Problem Solving

- Bring a project manager’s discipline to ambiguous, cross-functional work.

- Define problems, organize workstreams, clarify owners, establish milestones, and drive deliverables to completion.

- Coordinate across technical, operational, finance, strategy, and leadership teams to obtain required inputs and resolve blockers.

- Step into urgent or unstructured situations, create order quickly, and drive toward a practical solution.

- Manage multiple high-priority requests while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and sound judgment.

- Follow through persistently until commitments are completed and issues are resolved.

Executive and Operational Support

- Serve as a trusted, high-leverage partner to senior leadership on critical analyses, executive deliverables, and time-sensitive business issues.

- Independently take ownership of complex requests with limited initial direction.

- Help diagnose and resolve urgent business or operational “fire drills.”

- Exercise discretion when handling sensitive, confidential, or executive-level information.

- Provide flexibility during periods of elevated business activity, including occasional support outside standard working hours when urgent circumstances require it.

The ideal candidate is a senior, hands-on operator who combines intellectual curiosity with an exceptional standard for accuracy. This person is comfortable going deep into the details without losing sight of the larger business narrative.

- Develop a strong working understanding of the company’s technical and operational environment.

Oracle’s Strategic Customer Engineering organization enables Oracle’s most strategic customers to successfully plan, acquire, and consume OCI services at scale. We partner across Oracle and with our customers to translate complex growth plans into clear strategies, coordinated execution, and successful business outcomes.
This role will lead high-impact, cross-organizational programs supporting strategic customers and business priorities. The ideal candidate brings strong program leadership, business judgment, executive communication, and the ability to create alignment and drive results across complex organizations.
Disclaimer:

Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements.

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

US: Hiring Range in USD from: $114,600 to $234,600 per annum. May be eligible for bonus, equity, and compensation deferral.

Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted. Career Level - IC5
- Lead complex, high-impact programs spanning multiple teams and organizations, establishing strategy, priorities, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans.
- Partner with senior leaders, customers, and key stakeholders to align priorities, resolve competing requirements, and drive shared outcomes.
- Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and ensure teams remain aligned through execution and delivery.
- Identify and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, resource needs, and organizational blockers.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and insights to support decision-making.
- Establish program governance, success measures, and executive communications that provide clear visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and required actions.
- Use business and operational data to identify opportunities, improve outcomes, and inform priorities and investments.
- Drive cross-functional change and continuous improvement across processes, workflows, and operating models.
- Lead through influence, building alignment and accountability across teams without direct authority.
- Mentor program teams and promote strong program management practices across the organization.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Extensive experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs in complex organizations.
- Demonstrated ability to develop strategy and translate business objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.
- Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influence skills.
- Strong business judgment and analytical skills, including experience using data and metrics to guide decisions.
- Experience managing program investments, budgets, resource planning, or forecasts.
- Demonstrated success navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex organizational dependencies.
- Track record of driving organizational change, process improvement, and operational efficiency.
- Experience working with enterprise customers and senior executives is highly desirable.
- Ability to establish direction, create alignment, and mobilize teams toward shared outcomes without direct authority.
Lead strategic, high-impact programs for Oracle’s most important customers, driving cross-functional alignment, executive decision-making, and successful business outcomes at scale.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Strategically, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive plans that optimize efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence in delivery. You will engage with key stakeholders, manage high-stakes vendor relationships, and navigate the complexities of regulatory compliance. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. This is a high- impact role that will lead, drive, and ensure the successful management and delivery of critical initiatives on our strategic roadmap. The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations.Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end-to-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds.

This role will oversee data center focused projects and initiatives. Managing these construction projects well is key to the overall success of customer deliveries. You will engage directly with our Colo and LV partners’ leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements to meet our customers’ needs. You will also engage with internal teams to make sure we deliver the proper design and process documentation to the Colo, execute on our ISP circuit contracts, and update all internal tracking tools for handover to our operations teams at the end of the project.

Key Responsibilities Include:
- Being the end-to-end leader in charge of the program, from shaping the approach to achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
- Project Planning: Develop and implement long-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.  Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.  Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seem less handoff.
- Project Management: Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
- Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
- Vendor Management: Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
- Budget Oversight: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost-effective use of resources and adherence to financial constraints.
- Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns.
- Quality Assurance: Implement and oversee quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of construction and operational efficiency. Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality will be required throughout the life of the project on an as needed basis.

Required Skills
- Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex challenges in a fast-paced construction environment.
- Strategic Planning: Expertise in developing and implementing long-term strategies and establishing program-level requirements for construction projects.
- Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of data center design, construction, and operational requirements, with a focus on cutting-edge technologies and sustainability.
- Project Management: Proven expertise in managing large-scale data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery including advanced project scheduling and tracking.
- Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of project managers, engineers, and construction professionals.
- Budget Management: Proficiency in creating, managing, and optimizing project budgets to ensure cost-effective use of resources.
- Risk Management: Ability to identify potential risks and develop effective mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
- Vendor Management: Extensive experience in selecting, negotiating, and managing contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers.
This role is on-site in Abilene, TX. If you do not live in Abilene, TX, relocation is provided.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) powers Oracle’s global cloud services through highly available, large-scale, enterprise-grade data center environments. The Data Center Infrastructure Operations / Facilities team plays a critical role in sustaining OCI’s performance, security, and operational resilience by ensuring infrastructure systems operate reliably at scale.
You will join a technically rigorous organization with a culture grounded in operational excellence, disciplined processes, and continuous improvement, where infrastructure reliability, safety, and execution quality are foundational to delivering cloud services worldwide.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Program Manager, OCI Capacity & Demand Planning
jobs.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Lead Principal Program Manager to lead critical capacity and demand planning programs supporting OCI’s AI/ML and cloud infrastructure priorities. This role will translate business strategy, customer demand, product roadmaps, and deployment readiness into integrated near-term and long-range capacity plans across GPU, compute, storage, and network infrastructure.

Operating at the intersection of Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Data Center Delivery, Capacity Management, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance, this leader will bring clarity to highly ambiguous planning challenges where supply availability, site readiness, capital commitments, deployment timing, revenue realization, and customer priorities must be balanced.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders, lead complex cross-organizational initiatives with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, and establish the governance, analytical frameworks, and operating rhythms required to scale OCI effectively. The role will translate complex business and technical inputs into executive-level recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes, improve decision quality, and optimize capital efficiency and margin performance.

jobs.description:
Overview
The FTO connects teams across Oracle to improve how Federal Consulting delivers. The office removes barriers, connects expertise, and advances systemic solutions across four areas: delivery excellence, operational improvement, automation and time to value, and reporting and tooling.

As a Lead Federal Project Manager, you will independently lead multiple FTO initiatives end-to-end, from request intake and planning through implementation, adoption, and closure. You will translate broad priorities and recurring delivery challenges into actionable plans, coordinate accountable owners, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.  You will lead the assigned transformation projects and coordinate the changes needed to help those teams succeed.

This role requires an experienced project leader who understands Federal program environments, navigates ambiguity, and earns trust with senior leaders and working teams. You will partner with FTO functional leads, Oracle Health Government Services, Federal Consulting, and additional teams such as product, engineering, support, and hosting to advance Federal priorities.
Key Responsibilities

- Lead multiple complex FTO projects across delivery, operations, technology, reporting, and transformation enablement, adapting your approach to each initiative while maintaining consistent project discipline.

- Translate program priorities and stakeholder requests into clear problem statements, scope, deliverables, success measures, schedules, resource needs, and accountable owners. Manage dependencies and changes across concurrent initiatives.

- Apply the FTO request management process: intake, triage, assign ownership, take action, and report back. Work with functional leads and governance partners to prioritize requests and maintain visibility through resolution.

- Drive execution of project plans through cross-functional working sessions, milestone reviews, and action tracking. Identify blockers early, resolve issues with the appropriate owners, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.

- Maintain accurate project records in Jira and established FTO tools, including milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action owners. Provide a reliable view of progress and delivery  health.

- Prepare concise executive updates and materials for FTO governance forums and VA readouts through established stakeholder channels. Communicate results, near-term risks, and decisions needed, and close the feedback loop with requestors and impacted teams.

Key Responsibilities Continued

- Lead process improvement efforts that address recurring delivery and operational challenges. Partner with subject matter experts to understand root causes, simplify handoffs, and implement sustainable solutions.

- Coordinate initiatives such as staffing and demand visibility, financial forecasting and transparency, delivery risk resolution, workflow improvements, dashboards, and technology or AI-enabled efficiencies. Partner with technical owners on requirements, validation, and implementation.

- Integrate applicable Federal contract, security, access, and compliance requirements into project plans, working with responsible experts to address constraints and readiness dependencies.

- Partner with Communications, Transformation Enablement, and Federal Capability and Knowledge Leads on stakeholder engagement, readiness, training, and adoption. Confirm operational ownership and support before project closure.

- Track outcomes against agreed success measures, validate results with stakeholders, and capture lessons learned. Mentor project managers and contribute reusable methods that strengthen FTO project delivery.

- 8 or more years of experience in project management or program leadership, including leading complex initiatives supporting Federal programs.

- Demonstrated success independently managing multiple projects with competing priorities, cross-functional dependencies, and senior stakeholder visibility.

- Experience working within Federal program governance and coordinating contract, security, access, or compliance requirements with the appropriate functional experts.

- Strong planning, risk management, problem-solving, and process improvement skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive reporting, meeting facilitation, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

- Ability to use project data and performance measures to identify trends, recommend actions, and demonstrate results.

- US citizenship with the ability to obtain a Federal security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience supporting Federal, particularly healthcare technology, electronic health record modernization, deployment, or operational improvement initiatives.

- PMP or another advanced project management certification.

- Experience in a transformation office, program management office, or large Federal healthcare program involving multiple delivery and technology organizations.

- Experience with Jira, executive dashboards, and portfolio reporting; familiarity with Oracle APEX or similar workflow and reporting tools.

- Experience leading initiatives involving resource capacity, financial forecasting, automation, technology implementation, or organizational change and adoption.

Logistics Network Design
- Assess multi-procurement supply chain models and identify optimal logistics network solutions.
- Design commercially and operationally scalable solutions that support Oracle’s hyper-scale growth.
- Apply best-in-class logistics practices and innovative thinking to network design.
- Lead implementation and successful delivery of complex logistics solutions.

Cost Control
- Maintain financial control and visibility across transcontinental, parcel, warehousing and freight spend.
- Analyze supplier charges, rates, surcharges, volumes and service mix to identify variances and cost leakage.
- Reconcile invoices and identify recovery, savings and renegotiation opportunities.
- Provide recurring reporting and scenario analysis on trends, exceptions, financial exposure and corrective actions.
- Support stakeholders with commercial insight, including analytical support for logistics activities.

Freight Tariff Management and Control
- Review and approve supplier quotations against agreed tariffs, service requirements and contractual terms.
- Challenge unsupported, exceptional or non-compliant charges.
- Maintain an auditable approval trail for material pricing exceptions.
- Benchmark supplier rates across lanes, modes and services to assess competitiveness and support negotiations  to drive cost-reduction opportunities.

MSA and Contract Business Development
- Develop and maintain SOWs, SOPs and contractual frameworks for key freight suppliers.
- Define clear scope, service levels, pricing principles, responsibilities, controls and performance expectations.
- Drive consistent commercial and operating standards across multiple providers.
- Support local requirements, risk management, capacity planning and contractual updates.
- Identify and drive continuous supplier performance and service improvement opportunities.

Supplier Program Management
- Coordinate initiatives across a multi-supplier supply chain.
- Standardize program governance, processes and supplier management activities.
- Coordinate supplier scorecards and performance tracking.
- Lead and align quarterly business reviews across suppliers.
- Ensure cross-supplier initiatives are consistently managed and executed.

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.

- 8+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain operations, or global freight management.

- Deep knowledge of transportation management systems, preferably Oracle Transportation Management (OTM).

- Experience supporting global data center, cloud infrastructure, or high-tech supply chains is highly desirable.

- Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) subject matter expertise.

- Strong understanding of domestic and international freight operations, carrier management, and transportation planning.

- Experience with reverse logistics and asset recovery operations.

- Proven program management experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

- Experience collaborating with Finance, IT, Trade Compliance, Tax, Procurement, and Operations organizations.

- Strong commercial negotiation and supplier relationship management skills.

- Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence tools.

- Experience applying AI and automation technologies to improve logistics operations and decision-making.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority in a fast-paced, global environment.

Success Measures
Success in this role will be measured by:
- On-time delivery performance for critical OCI infrastructure shipments.

- Successful execution of transportation support for large-scale global deployments.

- Effective integration and performance management of transportation carriers.

- Improved transportation cost efficiency and carrier performance.

- Increased visibility and operational control through Oracle Transportation Management.

- Efficient execution of reverse logistics transportation programs.

- Successful delivery of cross-functional transportation initiatives.

- Increased automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven insights supporting transportation operations.

jobs.title: Quality Program Manager – Global Hardware Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Oracle is seeking an experienced Quality Program Manager to lead the Global Stop Ship and Purge program across our hardware supply chain.

The Stop Ship and Purge program is Oracle’s global emergency-response system for managing critical hardware quality issues. When a potential quality concern is identified, this role leads the structured process for containing affected products, stopping movement through the supply chain, coordinating investigation and remediation, and safely restoring operations once the issue has been resolved.

This highly visible role provides end-to-end program leadership, from initial issue identification through containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, recovery, and closure. The Quality Program Manager will ensure every quality event follows a consistent framework, maintains complete traceability, meets audit requirements, and minimizes potential impact to Oracle’s customers, field operations, and OCI data centers.

The ideal candidate brings deep quality program-management experience within a manufacturing or complex hardware supply-chain environment. Success requires the ability to lead urgent, cross-functional programs involving external manufacturers, suppliers, product teams, engineering, field services, logistics, and data-center operations.

- Maintain full traceability and audit-ready records demonstrating how quality issues and corrective actions were managed.

- Engage with manufacturing, product-design teams, services, account teams, and customers to identify quality trends and improvement opportunities.
- Define, track, analyze, and report quality metrics, case-rate data, emerging trends, corrective actions, and program health.
- Present risks, decisions, recovery plans, and quality-performance insights to senior leadership.
- Use Voice of the Customer and field-quality data to improve products, processes, controls, and customer outcomes.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen quality-management systems and improve the efficiency and consistency of global quality-response processes.
- Manage assigned quality initiatives end to end, including requirements, schedules, dependencies, risks, milestones, executive reporting, and operational handoffs.
- Establish operating rhythms that provide clear visibility into program status, decisions, ownership, escalations, and outstanding actions.
- Support ongoing compliance with applicable quality standards, certification requirements, and internal controls.

Required Qualifications
- Strong quality program-management experience within manufacturing, hardware, electronics, or another complex physical-product supply chain.
- Demonstrated experience leading high-priority quality events from initial containment through investigation, corrective action, validation, and release.
- Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, failure analysis, and continuous improvement.
- Experience collaborating with external manufacturers, suppliers, engineering, product, logistics, field-service, and customer-facing teams.
- Strong understanding of manufacturing and supply-chain control points, including how products or materials are stopped, contained, evaluated, released, and returned to production.
- Experience creating and maintaining formal controls, process documentation, quality records, and audit traceability.
- Ability to lead complex programs involving multiple organizations, competing priorities, incomplete information, and urgent timelines.
- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify trends, define meaningful quality metrics, and translate data into actions and recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex quality issues, risks, and decisions to technical teams and executive leaders.
- Ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting server, networking, storage, semiconductor, data-center, or other complex hardware products.
- Knowledge of ISO 9001, TL 9000, or comparable quality-management standards.
- Experience supporting product-compliance certifications or audits involving standards such as UL, CSA, TUV, CQC, or CCC.
- Experience developing or delivering Root Cause and Corrective Action training.
- Background in supplier quality, reliability engineering, manufacturing quality, or field-quality management.
- Experience with supply-chain security, hardware authenticity, chain-of-custody controls, counterfeit-component prevention, or secure product lifecycle management.
- Familiarity with security and risk frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, DoD, or CMMC.
- Experience conducting supplier risk or security assessments and tracking corrective actions and remediation plans.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will create a disciplined and repeatable approach to managing critical hardware quality events globally. They will ensure that Oracle responds quickly when issues arise, maintains complete visibility and traceability throughout the process, protects customers and field operations, and safely restores supply as efficiently as possible.
Oracle is hiring a Quality Program Manager to lead its Global Stop Ship and Purge program—driving urgent, end-to-end response to critical hardware quality issues across Oracle’s global supply chain, from containment through corrective action and recovery. This highly visible role partners with suppliers, manufacturers, engineering, product, logistics, field services, and OCI data-center operations to protect customers and restore operations safely. The role can sit onsite in Austin, TX; Nashville, TN; or Houston, TX, with relocation assistance available.

- Strong troubleshooting judgment and calm decision-making under pressure.

- Deep commitment to safety, procedure adherence, and documentation rigor.

- Clear communicator able to translate plant conditions, risks, and actions for varied stakeholders.

- Strong planning and execution discipline across maintenance, backlog, and operational priorities.

- Ability to lead technicians and vendors while reinforcing accountability and consistent field execution.

- Familiarity with predictive maintenance, trend analysis, controls integration, and operational performance monitoring.

- Drive migration readiness, validation, prioritization, and issue resolution across the OCI website portfolio, including 239 product and solution pages on oracle.com/cloud and the assessment of a further 183 AI pages.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager (OCI Site Design)
jobs.description:
The Site Design Planner develops accurate, integrated, and actionable site designs for new Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) data center builds and expansions. This role translates business demand, customer requirements, and infrastructure capacity needs into an executable site and data-hall plan.

A successful team member brings together compute, power, network, connectivity, and physical-layout inputs to create a single source of truth for each site. They use sound judgment to balance customer priorities, infrastructure constraints, deployment sequencing, and available capacity, while driving alignment across planning, engineering, design, delivery, sourcing, and operations teams.

Responsibilities
Reporting to the Director of DC Site Design & Planning, this role will:

-
Convert business demand, customer requirements, and capacity plans into integrated site designs for greenfield data centers and site expansions.

-
Own the site-design process from initial demand intake through an approved, actionable handoff to Data Center Design and Delivery teams.

-
Develop data-hall layouts and rack, compute, power, and infrastructure allocation plans that meet customer needs, deployment timelines, and site constraints.

-
Integrate network capacity, physical connectivity, and infrastructure requirements from partner organizations into a cohesive site plan.

-
Partner with Networking, Connectivity, Compute, Capacity Planning, DC Engineering, DC Design, Delivery, and Sourcing teams to resolve dependencies, constraints, and design tradeoffs.

-

jobs.description:
The Site Design Planner develops accurate, integrated, and actionable site designs for new Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) data center builds and expansions. This role translates business demand, customer requirements, and infrastructure capacity needs into an executable site and data-hall plan.

A successful team member brings together compute, power, network, connectivity, and physical-layout inputs to create a single source of truth for each site. They use sound judgment to balance customer priorities, infrastructure constraints, deployment sequencing, and available capacity, while driving alignment across planning, engineering, design, delivery, sourcing, and operations teams.

Reporting to the Director of DC Site Design & Planning, this role will:

Convert business demand, customer requirements, and capacity plans into integrated site designs for greenfield data centers and site expansions.

-
Own the site-design process from initial demand intake through an approved, actionable handoff to Data Center Design and Delivery teams.

-
Develop data-hall layouts and rack, compute, power, and infrastructure allocation plans that meet customer needs, deployment timelines, and site constraints.

-
Integrate network capacity, physical connectivity, and infrastructure requirements from partner organizations into a cohesive site plan.

-
Partner with Networking, Connectivity, Compute, Capacity Planning, DC Engineering, DC Design, Delivery, and Sourcing teams to resolve dependencies, constraints, and design tradeoffs.

-
Support complex deployments, including AI networking, high-density GPU infrastructure, and multi-plane fabric designs, ensuring site plans account for associated power, cooling, network, and connectivity requirements.

Use data and judgment to recommend allocation, sequencing, and design decisions that balance customer commitments, business priorities, and infrastructure availability.

We’re on a journey to advance how health happens with technologies that support clinicians, inspire innovation, empower patients, and save lives. Our mission? To create a human-centric healthcare experience powered by unified global data.

It’s a big challenge, but big challenges are what we do best. We’re already transforming some of the world’s largest health systems—helping them turn data into lifesaving decisions and better patient care.

We want people just as dedicated as we are making history with the advancement of Federal Healthcare systems. If you’re excited about making healthcare more human, you’ve come to the right place.

About This Position:

We are looking for a detail-oriented, results-driven professional to enhance action management, portfolio visibility, and operational excellence across executive priorities and key account initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for tracking and reporting on executive actions and strategic priorities, promoting consistent use of governance and project management frameworks, and empowering senior leaders to advance high-priority initiatives efficiently. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, responds swiftly to urgent needs, and demonstrates exceptional cross-functional collaboration.

You will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to support strategic projects and oversee initiatives aligned with program objectives, goals, and KPIs. Responsibilities include tracking, managing, and ensuring follow-through on executive actions, while maintaining clear accountability, timely delivery, and transparent reporting within a regulated federal setting.
Disclaimer:

Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements.

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

US: Hiring Range in USD from: $81,700 to $166,100 per annum. May be eligible for bonus and equity.

Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted. Career Level - IC3
Action Tracking for Executives & Accounts
- Own the centralized tracking of executive-level actions, decisions, and follow-ups to ensure timely completion and visibility.
- Track progress and outcomes for initiatives aligned with key accounts and enterprise-wide objectives.
- Report regularly to senior leaders on action statuses and dependencies.
- Maintain and report on strategic priorities, KPIs, and goal attainment across key initiatives, ensuring clear visibility, accountability, and alignment for executive leadership.

Process Oversight
- Ensure consistent adoption of project management frameworks, governance tools, and operating models across all teams.
- Provide coaching and guidance on process compliance while identifying opportunities for streamlining and improvement.

Project & Portfolio Tracking
- Track and report on projects and programs across departments, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and timelines.
- Monitor progress against defined milestones, actions, and success metrics.
- Develop dashboards, status reports, and summaries for executive leadership.

Support for Strategic Projects
- Partner with senior leadership to provide operational and execution support for high-priority, strategic initiatives.
- Coordinate cross-functional resources, drive timelines, and remove blockers to accelerate progress on strategic goals.

Agility & Critical Issue Response
- Step in to support or lead high-impact or urgent projects and initiatives as needed.
- Triage and manage unexpected issues, ensuring continuity and forward momentum.
- Adapt quickly to changing priorities, serving as a flexible operator across teams and functions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Foster collaboration across accounts and organizations, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and execution.
- Serve as a key liaison between teams to drive shared understanding and problem-solving.
- Champion a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
- Strategic projects are delivered with high quality, on time, and in alignment with executive expectations.
- Executive actions and account initiatives are tracked and acted upon with visibility and accountability.
- Critical issues are handled promptly with minimal disruption.
- Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
- 8+ years of experience in project management, strategic program management, or operations in a complex, cross-functional environment.
- Previous Federal Contracting experience preferred.
- Required travel up to 20%.
- US Citizenship is required with an ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance.

Location: Rosslyn, VA office.

Oracle Health Mission Statement:
At Oracle, we believe we have a moral obligation to leverage our resources, knowledge, and expertise—as well as our successes in other industries—and apply them to healthcare and health research to make a meaningful impact. Healthcare is personal, and the work we do truly makes a difference for providers and patients.
This position will be located in the Rosslyn VA office.
In this role, you will be responsible for tracking and reporting on executive actions and strategic priorities, promoting consistent use of governance and project management frameworks, and empowering senior leaders to advance high-priority initiatives efficiently.

jobs.title: Principal NPI Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Program Manager to lead end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product Lifecycle Management programs supporting OCI's rapidly expanding cloud infrastructure portfolio.

Reporting to the Director or Senior Director of Supply Chain Operations, this individual contributor will own the operational execution of complex hardware programs from concept through production ramp, sustaining engineering, and end-of-life. As the operational leader for assigned programs, you will coordinate globally distributed teams across Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Planning, Quality, Procurement, and Data Center Operations to ensure successful product launches and lifecycle execution.

This role requires exceptional program management, operational expertise, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders to deliver products with speed, quality, and operational readiness. Success is measured by predictable execution, proactive risk management, and enabling scalable deployment of OCI infrastructure worldwide.
Disclaimer:

Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements.

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

US: Hiring Range in USD from: $102,300 to $209,500 per annum. May be eligible for bonus and equity.

Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted. Career Level - IC4
Key Responsibilities
New Product Introduction (NPI) Program Leadership
- Own end-to-end operational execution for complex NPI programs supporting OCI hardware and infrastructure products.
- Develop integrated program plans that align engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, and deployment organizations.
- Identify technical risks and dependencies that could impact launch schedule.
- Participate in technology and product roadmap reviews, technical design discussions, and complex hardware design issues with sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and drive resolution of open issues
- Ensure test infrastructure, test code, and production tooling are available to support manufacturing builds for launch.
- Drive all NPI phase gate and exit criteria to ensure operational readiness before launch.
- Drive execution across all phases of product introduction, ensuring milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and launch readiness remain on track.
- Coordinate global cross-functional teams to deliver successful product launches while balancing cost, schedule, quality, and supply continuity.
- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned NPI programs.

Program Execution & Change Management
- Drive alignment between Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Engineering throughout product builds and production ramps.
- Coordinate manufacturing readiness, material availability, production schedules, budgets, and deployment planning.
- Drive execution and solve complex technical and operational problems across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
- Possess deep technical understanding of the hardware product they are releasing or supporting. Ability to investigate technical issues and operational risk that will impact product release or revenue on a sustaining program.
- Proactively identify program risks, assess operational impacts, and drive mitigation strategies across engineering and supply chain organizations.
- Ensure engineering changes, schedule adjustments, and operational decisions are effectively communicated and executed.
- Support compliance with internal governance processes and operational readiness requirements.

Governance & Program Management
- Develop and manage detailed program schedules, milestones, dependencies, and risk registers.
- Facilitate cross-functional readiness reviews and phase gate meetings.
- Track program health using metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
- Drive issue resolution by coordinating stakeholders across multiple organizations.
- Ensure launch criteria and operational readiness requirements are successfully achieved prior to production release.

Product Lifecycle Management
- Manage products beyond initial launch through sustaining engineering, lifecycle planning, and end-of-life activities.
- Coordinate Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), product revisions, supplier transitions, and manufacturing updates.
- Lead stop-ship actions and drive long term corrective actions through the investigation of complex technical and operational issues and lead root-cause analysis and remediation efforts.
- Identify and resolve technical and operational blockers affecting manufacturing and test.
- Coordinate across engineering and other supply chain teams to resolve complex execution issues.
- Partner with Engineering and Supply Chain teams to qualify alternate sources and reduce supply risk.
- Lead operational planning for hardware product release, inventory disposition, product transitions, and end-of-life execution.
- Support continuous improvement of lifecycle management processes and operational governance.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner closely with: Product Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Planning, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and Data Center Operations
- Influence technical and operational decisions that improve manufacturability, scalability, quality, and deployment readiness.
- Build trusted relationships across engineering and operations teams to drive alignment without direct management authority.
- Provide program leadership and cross-team validation activities across globally distributed organizations.

Executive Communication
- Develop concise executive-level status reports highlighting program health, key milestones, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
- Present recommendations and trade-offs to senior leadership to support timely decision-making.
- Simplify complex technical and operational issues into actionable business updates.
- Maintain clear communication throughout all phases of program execution.
- Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve NPI execution, governance, operational readiness, and lifecycle management processes.
- Develop standardized tools, templates, dashboards, and best practices supporting scalable program execution.
- Leverage AI and automation tools, where appropriate, to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and enhance decision-making.
- Lead technical root-cause analysis for operational issues and drive lessons learned and post-launch reviews to improve future product introductions.
- Promote operational excellence through process optimization and data-driven decision making.

Required Qualifications
Experience
- 8+ years of experience in technical program management, operations program management, product engineering, supply chain, or New Product Introduction within hardware or cloud infrastructure environments.
- Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional hardware programs from concept through production and sustaining.
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs in a fast-paced, global organization.
- Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, supply planning, product lifecycle management, and engineering processes.
- Experience supporting hyperscale infrastructure, enterprise hardware, or cloud technology environments is preferred.

Technical Skills
- Deep knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) methodologies and operational readiness.
- Deep understanding on diagnosing technical and operational issues.
- Knowledge on leading technical investigations and corrective actions.
- Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes.
- Understanding of manufacturing operations, test and hardware deployment.
- Experience developing integrated program schedules, risk management plans, and executive dashboards.
- Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive operational decisions.
- Familiarity with ERP, PLM, and project management tools.

Professional Skills
- Exceptional program management and organizational skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and operations organizations.
- Ability to manage ambiguity and drive execution in rapidly changing environments.
- Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, or enterprise server platforms.
- Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or operational excellence methodologies.
- Experience managing global manufacturing partners and contract manufacturers.
- Knowledge of hardware qualification, manufacturing validation, and deployment readiness.
- PMP certification or equivalent program management experience is a plus.

Location : Santa Clara, CA | Seattle, WA
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Program Manager to lead end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product Lifecycle Management programs supporting OCI's rapidly expanding cloud infrastructure portfolio.

New Product Introduction (NPI) Program Leadership

- Develop integrated program plans that align engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, and deployment organizations.
- Identify technical risks and dependencies that could impact launch schedule.
- Participate in technology and product roadmap reviews, technical design discussions, and complex hardware design issues with sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and drive resolution of open issues
- Ensure test infrastructure, test code, and production tooling are available to support manufacturing builds for launch.
- Drive all NPI phase gate and exit criteria to ensure operational readiness before launch.

- Coordinate manufacturing readiness, material availability, production schedules, budgets, and deployment planning.
- Drive execution and solve complex technical and operational problems across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.

- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs in a fast-paced, global organization.
- Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, supply planning, product lifecycle management, and engineering processes.
- Experience supporting hyperscale infrastructure, enterprise hardware, or cloud technology environments is preferred.

Technical Skills
- Deep knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) methodologies and operational readiness.
- Deep understanding on diagnosing technical and operational issues.
- Knowledge on leading technical investigations and corrective actions.
- Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes.

Professional Skills

jobs.title: Operations Program Manager 4
jobs.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) continues to expand its global data center footprint, delivering some of the industry’s largest and most complex builds. The Data Center Inventory Control Management (DCICM) team ensures that inventory is tracked, deployed, and governed with the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and efficiency.

We are seeking an IC4 Technical Program Manager to oversee Global build projects, reporting directly into the Global DCICM leadership team. This role will focus on build material deployment, inventory governance, and third-party logistics (3PL) oversight, ensuring our largest data center programs maintain operational readiness and audit compliance.

This position carries a high level of accountability and autonomy. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to manage material lifecycle execution, drive accuracy and efficiency across builds, and partner effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders worldwide.

- End-to-End Inventory Tracking & Deployment: Own execution of material deployment activities across assigned builds, ensuring inventory accuracy, timely delivery, and governance against DCICM standards.
- 3PL Management: Oversee third-party logistics operations, ensuring compliance with Oracle’s chain of custody requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), and quality standards.
- Build Support: Partner with construction, engineering, and operations teams to align material flow and inventory readiness with aggressive build schedules.
- System Accuracy & Compliance: Ensure all inventory transactions, movements, and deployments are captured accurately within Oracle systems; maintain audit-ready records.
- Risk Management: Anticipate material and logistics risks, proactively developing mitigation strategies to protect build timelines and operational continuity.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary inventory control contact for regional builds, providing regular updates to global DCICM leadership, project teams, and external partners.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities for process automation, efficiency gains, and standardization in material management practices.
- Governance: Enforce global inventory policies while tailoring practices to regional build realities; ensure compliance with security, safety, and operational standards.

Required Skills & Experience
- Program/Project Management: Proven ability to manage large-scale, cross-functional programs with measurable outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
- Inventory Management Expertise: Strong understanding of material flow, inventory accuracy, reconciliation, and audit requirements.
- 3PL / Vendor Oversight: Demonstrated experience managing third-party logistics providers and ensuring SLA/governance adherence.
- Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret inventory data, highlight trends, and drive improvements across material deployment and accuracy.
- Risk & Issue Management: Skilled at identifying risks early, building mitigation plans, and maintaining project alignment.
- Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven success in engaging executive leadership, global peers, and vendor partners.
- Technical Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with ERP, WMS, and inventory management tools; Oracle Fusion or similar experience a plus.
- Adaptability: Comfortable working across regions, time zones, and with multiple concurrent builds under tight deadlines.
- Experience: 10+ years of experience in Program Management, Planning & Scheduling, Inventory Control, Logistics, or Warehouse Management.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in data center or large-scale infrastructure builds .
- Strong knowledge of material governance, chain of custody, and audit compliance requirements .
- Lean Six Sigma or other process improvement certification a plus.
- Ability to influence without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.
- Certification in inventory or supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CPIM, or CSCP) is preferred but not required.
Help power OCI’s global growth by keeping data center builds moving driving inventory accuracy, logistics coordination, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Center Inventory Control
jobs.description:
Overview

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) continues to expand its data center footprint, delivering large and complex builds across multiple regions. The Data Center Inventory Control Management (DCICM) team ensures that inventory is tracked, deployed, and governed with strong standards of accuracy, compliance, and efficiency.

We are seeking an IC3 Technical Program Manager to support inventory control activities for data center build projects within an assigned site, country, or regional area. This role will focus on build material deployment, inventory accuracy, logistics coordination, and third-party logistics (3PL) support, ensuring local data center programs maintain operational readiness and audit compliance.

This position carries a strong level of responsibility and requires the ability to manage day-to-day execution while escalating risks, blockers, and process gaps where needed. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to coordinate material lifecycle activities, support accurate inventory execution, and partner effectively with internal teams, vendors, and regional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

-
Inventory Tracking & Deployment: Support execution of material deployment activities across assigned site, country, or regional builds, ensuring inventory accuracy, timely material movement, and governance against DCICM standards.

-
3PL / Vendor Coordination: Work with third-party logistics providers to support Oracle’s chain of custody requirements, service level expectations, and quality standards. Escalate vendor performance concerns where appropriate.

-
Build Support: Partner with construction, engineering, logistics, operations, and regional inventory teams to align material flow and inventory readiness with local build schedules.

-
System Accuracy & Compliance: Ensure inventory transactions, movements, reconciliations, and deployments are captured accurately within Oracle systems; maintain records to support audit and compliance requirements.

-
Risk & Issue Management: Identify material, inventory, or logistics risks that may impact site or country-level build timelines. Support mitigation plans and escalate issues to regional or global DCICM leadership when needed.

-
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as an inventory control point of contact for assigned site or country-level activities, providing updates to regional DCICM leadership, project teams, and vendor partners.

-
Process Support & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to process improvements, reporting enhancements, and standardization efforts within the region. Support adoption of global DCICM processes at the local level.

-
Governance Support: Apply global inventory policies and regional operating procedures while ensuring compliance with security, safety, audit, and operational standards.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory accuracy, planning efficiency, and supply chain execution.

- Experience supporting hardware manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, networking, server, or high-tech operations environments preferred.

- Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) or manufacturing ramp activities preferred.

Technical & Functional Skills

- Strong understanding of materials management, manufacturing operations, inventory control, and supply chain planning processes.

- Experience with ERP, MRP, or supply chain management systems.

- Analytical mindset with experience developing and managing operational KPIs and performance metrics.

- Knowledge of manufacturing capacity planning, supplier management, and logistics operations.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

- Effective communicator with the ability to drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

- Proven ability to solve operational challenges using data-driven decision-making.

- Experience leading teams and influencing without direct authority across global organizations.
